what: In the middle of the Hero, a 12:5 video panel filling the screen width stays fixed while one screen is scrolled, and shrinks to a frame the width of the body column by cutting the sides an equal share and the bottom two shares (keeping its ratio) (sine.inOut, .6 screen). The video inside shrinks later to the same scale (sine.out, .1~1.5 screen). Meanwhile the frame settles from its first position down to a spot 380px (phone 180px) from the top of the screen (sine.inOut, .7 screen — the motion follows with the remaining ratio (1−e) seconds of expo.out), and once a full screen is scrolled it sticks there and rises with the document. Both scales follow late with 1s expo.out — a ryokan Hero where the full-screen night video of the month settles down into a single frame on paper
ease: sine.inOut (frame crop·settling down) · sine.out (inner video) · expo.out (follow)

options.target: End position — distance from the top of the screen where the frame’s top edge settles (px), default 380
options.target-narrow: End position at 767px and below (px), default 180
options.pad: Side margins of the end frame (px) — if empty, like the original max(screen width/2 − 660, 90)
options.pad-narrow: Side margin at 767px and below (ratio of screen width), default 0.1
options.start-narrow: Initial position at 767px or below (ratio of screen height), default 0.1623 — on wide screens, vertically centered
options.wrap-end: Where the outer frame crop ends (in screens), default 0.6
options.drop-end: Where the settling ends (screen section), default 0.7
options.scale-from: Point where the inner video starts to shrink (in screen heights), default 0.1
options.scale-to: Room the inner video fills (in screen heights), default 1.5
options.smooth: Time in seconds for the scale to catch up late, default 1 — 0 means immediately
options.[data-fx-part=clip]: Clipping panel (required) — video or photo inside
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Video or photo supplied separately inside panel
options.[data-fx-part=follow]: Text that settles down together with the frame (like a month name) — the panel gets is-text at section .725 and is-line at .825

note: Use it in the topmost section of the hero (the board is fixed on screen from the start). The board itself takes up space of screen height + target + end frame height, so the next section starts below it. In an inner scroll board (data-fx-scroller) it just runs its progression in place, with no pinning or settling. With reduced motion it shows the pinned end state.
